items.problem: Migrated code keeps Application.Suspending/Resuming event registrations, which do not exist on Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application -> CS1061 -> app never builds.
items.evidence: discrepancies.json buildErrors 'CS1061 ... Application.Suspending/Resuming not in WinUI 3'; session-log.txt turn 56.
items.root_cause: WinUI 3 has no UWP suspend/resume process-lifetime events; skill's lifecycle section covered only OnLaunched/OnActivated.
items.change: Added a 'Common build errors' subsection telling the agent to delete the Suspending/Resuming registration + handlers and move work to OnNavigatedTo/OnNavigatedFrom or Window.Closed.
items.expected_effect: Agent removes the dead events; this CS1061 cluster disappears.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no CS1061 on Application.Suspending/Resuming; build healthcheck no longer lists it.

items.problem: Member-level missing WinRT APIs (BLE secondary-PHY flags, IsLowEnergyUncoded2MPhySupported, UpdateAdvertisingParameters) on otherwise-supported types were left as compile errors, sinking the whole build (score 0).
items.evidence: migration-score.json winui_build_status; discrepancies.json buildErrors CS0117/CS1061 cluster.
items.root_cause: Skill only modeled whole-file/namespace deferral; no per-member stub/guard strategy, and the agent (mis)used try/catch on a compile-time error.
items.change: Added a 'Common build errors' subsection (stub/guard a missing member: false for capability reads, drop the call for writes; try/catch cannot mask a compile error; non-building app scores zero) and a Critical-Rules API-level bullet 'build-ability outranks member-level fidelity' clarifying this is neither a new defer row nor fabrication.
items.expected_effect: Agent stubs the missing members and reaches a clean build instead of stalling; scenarios become reachable.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, winui_build_status = clean build; the CS0117/CS1061 member cluster is gone; the 4 scenarios are no longer 'unreachable'.
